verdict.rationale: Adyen documents scoped, least-privilege API credentials via roles/permissions, per-merchant-account scoping, and the ability to create multiple credentials for finer-grained access control (adyen-supp-api-credential-scoping, adyen-docs-26). This scoping model explicitly extends to agent use cases: the MCP server docs specify exactly which roles to assign to an API key used for agent tool access, and recommend running only a subset of tools needed (adyen-supp-mcp-credential-roles, adyen-supp-mcp-tools). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that scoped credentials work correctly in practice with an AI agent, and no explicit UI walkthrough evidence of creating a minimal-scope credential specifically for an agent persona.
